name: pr-evidence
description: Reads a pull request's diff, its CI status for an exact commit and the failed jobs' logs, as one model-callable tool.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the pr_evidence tool on for new sessions. /pr-evidence on|off overrides it for a session.

allowSubagents.title: Allow subagents
allowSubagents.description: Let subagents call pr_evidence too, with the same limits. Off: their calls are refused.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Deadline for one pr_evidence call, 10 to 600. Sections not reached by then are reported as not collected.

maxOutputKiB.title: Largest result (KiB)
maxOutputKiB.description: Largest pr_evidence result, 16 to 64 KiB. Patches and log lines are dropped first, and every drop is listed.
